Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Growing a newsletter list from 640 to 1,150 subscribers in a single summer taught me that the most effective marketing lives at the intersection of a clear idea, sharp execution, and a real human moment. That instinct for connecting people to a brand is exactly what draws me to Coinbase's experiential marketing work, where events drive relationships with both consumer and institutional audiences at scale.

My event experience is early but concrete. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, I helped coordinate a weekend adoption event that brought in roughly 300 visitors, handling promotional content, on-site signage, and day-of logistics. Running the Westbrook Film Society's social channels for three years, I learned to manage overlapping deadlines, support creative development across formats, and measure what actually moved the needle (average screening attendance climbed from 35 to 60 per event). I bring hands-on skills in Canva, Excel, and Google Analytics, and I am a fast, disciplined learner when new platforms are involved.

I would welcome the chance to talk through how my background maps to the experiential marketing calendar your team is building. I am available at your convenience for a conversation.

Sincerely,
Maya Linden
